defects: Quantity over-billed: invoice claims 30,000 EACH (1,200 cases at 25/case) but GR-7714 records receipt of only 1,050 cases (26,250 EACH); 150 cases undelivered, balance ships April
Tax over-stated: invoice tax of 3,240.00 on 36,000.00 is 9.0%, versus the vendor's registered rate of 7.5%
Open credit memo CM-2026-014 (1,500.00) not applied by supplier
rationale: Unit price reconciles exactly across the UOM difference (PO 30.00/case at 25 each = 1.20 each), so there is no price variance and no grounds to hold. The decisive fact is the goods receipt: only 1,050 of 1,200 cases were delivered, with the supplier confirming the 150-case balance ships in April, so payment is limited to quantity received under three-way match. Payable is 1,050 cases x 30.00 = 31,500.00 net, plus tax at the vendor's correct 7.5% rate = 2,362.50 (the invoiced 9% is unsupported), less open credit memo CM-2026-014 of 1,500.00, giving 32,362.50. Undelivered balance to be invoiced on delivery.
